author: Myv
body:
Hello, I am back to show you my second completed map along with ASquarePig (iMan) and TigoCookie_ (Raikkou)!

We feel this is unique as there are not many 4TDM maps and we have put a lot of effort into the presentation and design which should play well.

Information

Team Sizes: 8v8.
Team Colours: Red, Green, Yellow and Purple
Duration: 10 minutes
First to: 75 points (this may go down to 50)

Download: Am clueless as to how to do this, require a Map Dev
XML: Require a Map Dev also asap!

Album: http://imgur.com/a/LbtvF

Feel free to leave feedback below, we appreciate all support.

Myv, iMan and Raikkou
